name: A Threat in Feralas
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Feralas is an ideal location for an accomplished champion to prove himself. A tribe of ogres called the Gordunni are the dominant military force there, and their numbers are growing. They must be stopped before they threaten our presence in Feralas.

A warrior I know of named Rok Orhan resides at Camp Mojache in Feralas; go to her. She will tell you more of the situation when you arrive.
narrative.objectives: Belgrom Rockmaul wants you to speak with Rok Orhan in Camp Mojache.
narrative.offerRewardText:
So, Belgrom sent you. You are just in time, friend.

Let me explain the situation, and then you can decide if you are up to the challenge... But if Belgrom sent you, I am sure your courage is unquestionable.

chain.subtitle: 3 quests from level 43 to 44, 7,350 XP in all.

quests.name: A Threat in Feralas
quests.objectiveText: Belgrom Rockmaul wants you to speak with Rok Orhan in Camp Mojache.

quests.name: The Ogres of Feralas
quests.objectiveText: Rok Orhan in Camp Mojache wants you to kill 10 Gordunni Ogres, 10 Gordunni Ogre-Magi, and 5 Gordunni Brutes.

quests.name: The Ogres of Feralas
quests.objectiveText: Rok Orhan in Camp Mojache wants you to kill 10 Gordunni Shaman, 10 Gordunni Warlocks, and 5 Gordunni Maulers.
